method: Consensus of two independent on-device engines (spike run 3 on the owner's iPhone SE, recorded in pp-ch3-run3-report.txt): for each sentence in the clip, the start of its first spoken word as heard by SpeechAnalyzer and by SFSpeechRecognizer, averaged when they agree within 0.3 s. 0.1.0 uses SFSpeechRecognizer only (SpeechAnalyzer stretched 'Not' over the preceding 5 s pause; its end, 15.66 s, agrees). 0.3.1 is left out: the engines disagree (SFSpeechRecognizer merged 'library he'). Version 1 (8 starts from pauses) was up to 0.4 s off; see tasks/spike-log.md.
